fr_html: LORD PHILLIMORE fait observer que les principes généraux visés par le No. 3 sont ceux qui sont acceptés par toutes les nations in foro domestico; tels certains principes de procédure, le principe de la bonne foi, le principe de la chose jugée etc.
en_html: LORD PHILLIMORE pointed out that the general principles referred to in point 3 were these which were accepted by all nations in foro domestico, such as certain principles of procedure, the principle of good faith, and the principle of res judicata, etc.
